ops-june: T-20m sterile window for v2.7.3 starts 2026-03-21 22:00 UTC. Stop non-emergency merges. Follow checklist below.

carmen-eng: Ack. I'll run the pin + smoke at T-10.

ops-june: Checklist: 1) Pin service/model -> no unpinned traffic 2) Run smoke 3) Canary 3% 4) Monitor p99/error 5) Ramp -> 25/50/100. Rollback owner = @sre-lina.

qa-karen: QA running quick regression. Will report failures here.

deploy-bot: Deploy command template: `/deploy release=v2.7.3 region=ap-south canary=3% smoke=true`

carmen-eng: Executing T-8: `/deploy release=v2.7.3 region=ap-south canary=3% smoke=true`

deploy-bot: Pin applied (pin-id: pin-6123). Smoke result: PASS (healthchecks ok, median latency +2ms).

carmen-eng: Canary live (3%) at 22:04 UTC. Watching traces and synthetic journeys.

sre-lina: Alert set: warn if error-rate >0.15%, fire >0.5%. Seeing a tiny spike on edge-1 (3x 502s) likely transient.

carmen-eng: Edge-1 spike resolved after connection reset. Overall error-rate 0.05%.

ops-june: Proceed to 25% in 8m if stable. No infra merges until post-window.

carmen-eng: `/deploy update-split release=v2.7.3 region=ap-south split=25`

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v2.7.3 -> 25% (ap-south).

qa-karen: Quick functional check: OK. Small rounding diff in internal metric; flagged for post-launch monitoring.

sre-lina: All alerting green. Ready to ramp.

carmen-eng: `/deploy update-split release=v2.7.3 region=ap-south split=50` -> executing.

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v2.7.3 -> 50% (ap-south).

ops-june: If no regressions, roll to 100% and lock freeze for 60m.

carmen-eng: Rolling to 100% now. `/deploy update-split release=v2.7.3 split=100 region=ap-south`

deploy-bot: Traffic split updated: v2.7.3 -> 100% (ap-south). Full rollout complete.

sre-lina: Final checks: p99 within SLO, error-rate steady. Locking freeze until 23:05 UTC.

ops-june: Thanks. Post-launch monitoring window active 60m. Update changelog after window. End thread.
